# ESP Web Tools serial-loader stub sources

The pinned ESP Web Tools10.4.0 bundle includes esptool-js0.6.0 loader binaries. These independent loader programs are GPL-2.0-or-later; this does not replace the MIT license for original LORA Tunnel firmware/web glue code. Original Cesanta/Espressif notices remain in each complete source tree.

`PROVENANCE.json` records exact immutable source commits, archive hashes, every retained source hash and the chip groups matched across binary text/data, entry and load-address fields. The source trees include their original build instructions. The esptool-js README4.6.1 reference is stale and is not used as source correspondence evidence.
